Author Denies Using AI for Award-Winning Story Amid Plagiarism Claims

Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied accusations of using artificial intelligence to write his award-winning story, which has caused an uproar on social media. Separately, a Quebec author admitted to past plagiarism but denied using AI for their novel. The Quebec author's publishing house has stated they stand by their author amid these allegations.
